Weekly flight log 🎈 Pocket Switzerland keeps gaining altitude:

🌅 the splash screen and map follow the time of day
🎨 new palette, brutalist interface
⛰️ passes, valleys and secondary peaks on the map
♿ accessibility pass: contrast, keyboard, VoiceOver
🗣️ all 4 national languages, Romansh included (Rumantsch Grischun)
🎒 a Swiss dialect dictionary in your backpack
🧩 behind the scenes: Storybook, and the UI moved to shadcn/ui and Base UI
